quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within an intersection.

activation.condition: A person stops, stands or parks a vehicle within an intersection.

obligation.description: Do not stop, stand or park there when no statutory exception applies.

exceptions.source_clause: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.description: A halt necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic; causal necessity remains unresolved.
A stop complying with applicable law; source and applicability remain unresolved.

exceptions.source_clause: the directions of a police officer
exceptions.description: A stop directed by a police officer; authority and original direction remain unresolved.
A stop directed by an applicable official traffic-control device; original display remains unresolved.

timing.description: Assess original parked or stopped footprint throughout the rest interval, preserving 20 Hz sample uncertainty.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original conflict actors, trajectory and causal necessity require review; no numeric necessity threshold is supplied.
An applicable legal direction and reason for stopping cannot be inferred from the parking controller.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: the directions of a police officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original officer identity, authority, communication and applicability require independent source review.
Original official device identity, display, applicability and direction require independent source review.
